data.summary: Fresh observation in structured fault/error-code domains (PLC + Medical). Instrument fault_need_classifier_v3 passed discrimination test (G1 FPR=0.000, G2 TPR=0.704, G3 FNR=0.296). Applied to 16 practitioner rows from MrPLC (9) and MedWrench (7). Results: 43.8% served, 56.2% unserved. Key findings: vendor knowledge gaps (2), recurrence after fix (1), specific error codes cited (37.5%), high view counts on error threads (>1000 views on 2 PLC threads). MedWrench view counts unavailable so classifier conservative there. No candidate emerges; high-value signal is PLC-1 pattern (vendor-unsure + recurrence).
